note: Message origin contract. A filed message records where it came from: "panel" for a reply typed in the chat panel, "agent" for the agent's own reported output, null when nobody said. All My Agents records the origin; it does not decide what it means — a consumer that needs to know whether a message came from James reads the origin. Text typed into a terminal never travels a route that files messages, so it is never tagged at all. The cases are asserted by both suites: web/test/message-origin.test.js and Tests/AllMyAgentsTests/MessageOriginContractTests.swift.
